title: 효과적인 대학 교수-학습지원체제 수립을 위한 요구분석과 운영전략

abstracts.value: 본 연구에서는 대학의 교수-학습지원 시스템을 보다 체계적이고 효과적으로 구축 운영할 수 있는 방안을 탐색하고자 하였다. 다시 말해서 본 연구를 통해 국내 대학의 교수-학습지원체제 개발·지원·운영상의 핵심적 문제는 무엇이며, 이러한 문제해결을 위한 실천적 대안으로서 대학의 교수-학습지원체제는 구체적으로 어떠한 내용으로 구축될 수 있고, 이를 토대로 어떠한 실천적 운영전략으로서 교수-학습센터가 운영될 수 있는지를 합리적으로 도출해 내고자 하였다. 이러한 연구목적 달성을 위해 국내외 대학 교수-학습지원체제에 대한 현황 실태조사 및 요구조사를 실시함으로써 대학 교수-학습지원체제의 핵심적 문제와 해결방향 및 과제가 무엇인지를 실증적으로 파악, 제시하였으며 이를 토대로 대학 교수-학습지원센터(CTL)의 구축 모형 모형은 어떻게 개념적으로 유형화될 수 있으며, 센터의 효율적 운영을 위한 실천적 포트폴리오와 단계별 사업추진 시나리오는 어떻게 수립될 수 있는지를 제안하였다. 본 연구결과를 통해 향후 효과적인 대학 교수-학습지원체제의 구축 운영을 위해서 무엇을 어떻게 추진해 나가야 하는지를 시사받을 수 있을 것으로 기대된다.

The purpose of this study was to construct and manage instructional service system to promote the improvement of instructional competency of professors in university. The Center for Teaching and Learning(CTL) was originally established to develope the instructional faculty training program and their teaching assistant staffs. However, in recent times, many universities have elaborate to improve the quality of teaching-learning in their classroom processes. And so, CTL has also played an increasingly important role in helping faculty to become aware of and use instructional technology appropriate for their effective teaching style and methods.
But most of universities don't have a "know-how" to construct and manage their CTL because of various factors: circumstances, financial, administrative, culture etc..
In terms of this research, CTL aims to promote effective instructional service system in many university and excellence in teaching-learning inside and outside their classroom. CTL is to look forward to considering teaching equally valued with research as a professional commitment of faculty and teaching assistants, and to provide the instructional consulting programs and resources to make excellent instructional outcomes as possible as.
It is necessary for us to recognize that effective CTL encompasses more than just the establishment of institution. Excellent teaching-learning service system, first of all, must be prepare a systematic approach to whole educational system to gain the professors' teaching achievement in a high degree and convince them of the importance of what & how is being taught and learned. It goes on to communicate not only instructional information and concepts but to develop powers of analysis, synthesis, judgment, and evaluation in their context of instruction. When CTL has will truly succeeded, professors have a new competency in their instruction to cope with changed roles and desired committment on their own teaching world. In conclusion, educational technologists have to concern and effort to contribute to develope the instructional service system in our universities in terms of effective construction and management of CTL.
